description: A modern portfolio platform built with interactive desktop-style windows and templates.

Developed a website using next.js and gemini. It will take a form that user fill out and gemini will make five project idea and user can choose one and go more in depth on the project through a chatbot.

Developed a book tracking web app that stores book data in LocalStorage as JSON.
Built dynamic JavaScript card rendering to display stored books in a responsive UI.
Implemented client-side CRUD-style functionality for managing book entries

Deployed a Proxmox-based virtualization server hosting multiple Linux VMs.
Configured NAS storage for centralized file management and backups.
Implemented WireGuard VPN for secure remote access to the home network.
